title: Hard-coded error messages need custom error types
description: JournalWriter.swift:39 uses generic NSError with hard-coded domain. Poor error diagnostics, difficult debugging. Create proper custom error types for better error handling.

title: Legacy NSString usage not Swift 6.2 compliant
description: Bot.swift:18,32 and TextHandler.swift:45 use 'as NSString).appendingPathComponent()' instead of modern Swift URL APIs. Not Swift 6.2 compliant, potential encoding issues. Use URL.appendingPathComponent() instead.

title: API key exposure risk in configuration
description: Configuration handling has no explicit security measures to prevent API key logging/exposure. Potential credential leakage. Ensure secrets are not logged, consider encrypted storage.

title: Missing test coverage for core Bot logic
description: No tests for Bot.swift and main application flow. Critical bot functionality is completely untested, high risk of regressions. Add comprehensive tests for bot message handling and error scenarios.

title: Critical: Bot crashes on any error with fatalError
description: Bot.swift:56 uses fatalError() when server stops, terminating entire process. No recovery mechanism. Replace with proper error handling, logging, and restart logic.

title: Missing configuration validation
description: ConfigReader.swift has no validation of configuration values (file paths, API keys, user IDs). Runtime failures with invalid configurations. Add comprehensive validation in config reading.

title: Replace print() with proper logging framework
description: Throughout codebase uses print() instead of proper logging framework. Poor production debugging, no log levels or structured logging. Implement swift-log for structured logging.

title: Critical: Synchronous API calls block main loop
description: Bot.swift:21 uses nextUpdateSync() instead of async variant, blocking main thread. Bot becomes unresponsive during network delays. Fix: Use nextUpdate() with async/await pattern.

title: Race condition in DateFormatter usage
description: DateFormatter.swift:12-22 has DateFormatter that is not thread-safe but used in actor without proper isolation. Potential crashes or incorrect formatting under concurrent access. Create new DateFormatter instances per call or ensure proper actor isolation.

title: URL regex vulnerability in LinkProcessor
description: LinkProcessor.swift:22-27 has incorrect while loop that always returns after first iteration, doesn't handle all punctuation properly. Links not properly cleaned, potential injection issues. Fix while loop logic and add comprehensive punctuation handling.

title: Critical: Infinite loop with no graceful shutdown
description: Bot.swift:21-55 creates infinite while loop with no exit strategy. Cannot stop bot gracefully, causes resource leaks. Add signal handlers for graceful shutdown and timeout mechanisms.
